name: Warrior's Revenge
author: LunarBlade
description:
Press Space to Interact.
Fixed Inconsistent jump height.
Fixed Player getting stuck inside tiles.

A 2d Platformer game, with two levels, one simple and one boss level, also has a local multiplayer mode.

No story added yet.

Let me know your thoughts, Thanks!.

Controls:-
Player 1 - Arrow keys and Z and Space to interact.
Player 2 - WASD and G
